not_applicable.reason: Only the part about child processes. The tool starts no worker and no child process, so it never passes a credential to one. Case mask-009 is skipped.

Only the part about writing a profile. The tool reads profiles and never writes one, so cases perm-001, perm-002 and perm-003 are skipped. The config file that cli init writes has mode 0600, and a folder it creates has mode 0700.

differences.summary: An unknown key in the config file gives a warning, not a debug line. The config file also holds alert rules and other settings, and the warning is how a person finds a mistyped setting name. An unknown key in a profile gives a debug line, as the rule says.

These cases expect the notices that a tool prints until it applies Level 3. This tool applies Level 3, so it has no such notice to print. A partial source is the error partial_source, and .env wins over the default config file without a notice.
